description: Header file defining classes and enums for generating and representing Xcode project files, including PBX objects, build phases, targets, groups, and configurations.

classes.name: PBXObject
classes.description: Base class for all PBX objects representing elements of an Xcode project.

classes.name: PBXBuildPhase
classes.description: Represents a build phase in an Xcode project, containing build files.

classes.name: PBXTarget
classes.description: Represents a build target in an Xcode project, including configurations, dependencies, and build phases.

classes.name: PBXAggregateTarget
classes.description: Represents an aggregate target in an Xcode project, derived from PBXTarget.

classes.name: PBXBuildFile
classes.description: Represents a build file associated with a build phase.

classes.name: PBXContainerItemProxy
classes.description: Proxy object linking targets and projects.

classes.name: PBXFileReference
classes.description: Represents a file reference in the project.

classes.name: PBXGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of files or other groups.

classes.name: PBXNativeTarget
classes.description: Native build target with associated resources and files.

classes.name: PBXProject
classes.description: Represents the entire Xcode project, including targets, groups, and configurations.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts PBXObjectClass enum to string representation.
